title: Qwen vs the computer inside its own weights
black: mcu-max chess engine (depth 2, ≤1000 nodes) running on the RISC-V CPU compiled into Qwen's own weights
about: Every engine move is computed by the RV32IM CPU that lives in Qwenputer's extra layers (its RAM is the model's Gated DeltaNet state). Instruction counts are exact for finished moves; the in-progress count is an estimate from tokens.
